description: A save when the project folder has audio: the old version gets a copy of it in a media folder of the same name inside the oldversion folder, so it still opens when the original audio is gone.

result.summary: opentune_save_project: saved the project to its file (path in path), replacing its previous content; a copy of the replaced content was kept in the oldversion folder next to that file (path in oldVersion.path); opening that copy with opentune_open_project goes back to it. The project is no longer marked as changed. Not stored in the project file: the undo and redo history, global preferences. OpenTune also copies the audio the project uses into a media folder next to the project file: a folder named after it with _Media added, or in a build that implements an earlier specification the Project_Media folder that all the project files of the directory share, where a file of the same name is replaced.

lines.text: This change can be neither undone nor reverted by any request of the protocol.
The change is not saved in the project file.
Not undoable (OpenTune has no undo for this). No request of the protocol can restore the previous state.
